about: Synthetic public requests for help, written for this prototype's benchmark (18 October 2026). Not real messages. Sinhala and Tamil text needs native-speaker review. Labels: decision filed (real, an incident covers the area), hold (real, no incident), closed (junk), verify (doubtful), not_closed (anything except closed: danger words inside junk-looking text). need and people are scored only where given; people is a number only when the text states a count of people. need may list several acceptable answers.

cases.text: Our electricity has been off since the storm last night. A tree fell on the power line near the school.
Power cut for 2 days in our lane, the transformer was flooded. 25 people here, elderly need fans and lights.
